name: Angellus: Asas do Anoitecer
storyline: Angellus is the celestial realm of guardian angels, while the demons dwell in Dibérnia; their ancient war over human souls on the world of Martel ended when the angel Einglenn sacrificed immortality to erect a barrier between realms. When Cello, a renowned guardian, alters a human’s lifeline out of love—a forbidden act—he is exiled as a fallen angel. Luminus, seeking to understand human emotions and his friend’s choice, escapes Angellus to pursue the meaning of love, setting events in motion that may alter the fate of all worlds.
summary: In a fictional world anticipating a grand festival, you experience the intertwined stories of two young protagonists whose painful destinies conceal deeper mysteries across angelic and demonic realms. Built with RPG Maker VX, Angellus blends exploration, narrative, and classic RPG progression in an isometric presentation.
